        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 8px;

        background: transparent;
        border: 1px solid #6366f166;
        color: #6366f1;
        border-radius: 4px;

        opacity: 0.5;

      }

        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 6px;
        background: transparent;
        border: 1px solid #55557044;
        color: #8888a0;
        border-radius: 4px;
        font-family: 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Code', 'Fira Code', 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
        font-size: 0.65rem;
        padding: 4px 8px;
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .agent-session-copy:hover:not(:disabled) {
        color: #6366f1;
        border-color: #6366f166;
        background: #6366f114;
      }
      .agent-session-copy:disabled {
        opacity: 0.5;
        cursor: default;
      }

        color: #00ff88;
        border-color: #00ff8855;
      }

        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 6px;
        background: transparent;
        border: 1px solid #6366f166;
        color: #6366f1;
        border-radius: 4px;
        font-family: 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Code', 'Fira Code', 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
        font-size: 0.65rem;
        padding: 4px 8px;
        cursor: pointer;
      }
      .agent-session-open:hover:not(:disabled) {
        background: #6366f118;
      }
      .agent-session-open:disabled {
        opacity: 0.5;
        cursor: default;
      }
      .agent-session-copy-icon,
      .agent-session-open-icon {
        width: 12px;
        height: 12px;
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }
      .agent-session-copied-block {
        flex-basis: 100%;
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 4px;
      }
      .agent-session-paste-on {
        font-family: 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Code', 'Fira Code', 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
        font-size: 0.65rem;
        color: #6366f1;
      }
      .agent-session-copied {
        font-family: 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Code', 'Fira Code', 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
        font-size: 0.65rem;
        color: #8888a0;
        background: #1a1a2e;
        border-radius: 4px;
        padding: 6px 8px;
        overflow-x: auto;
        white-space: pre;
      }
      .agent-session-opened {
        color: #8888a0;
        flex-basis: 100%;
        font-size: 0.65rem;
      }

        color: #ff4444;
        flex-basis: 100%;
